# CINECOLOR

> > Professional color grading LUTs and film emulation tools for cinematographers and video editors across all major camera systems and log profiles.

CINECOLOR, founded by filmmaker Noam Kroll, provides professional-grade LUTs (.cube format) for cinema cameras, DSLRs, and mobile devices. The platform specializes in camera-specific color correction for Sony S-Log, Canon C-Log, ARRI Log-C, Blackmagic, and other professional log profiles, alongside creative film emulation packs and technical grading tools.

## Key Topics

- LUTs (Look-Up Tables)
- .cube format
- Color grading workflows
- Log profiles (S-Log3, C-Log, Log-C, F-Log, V-Log)
- Film emulation and film-look aesthetics
- Camera-specific LUTs (Sony, Blackmagic, Canon, ARRI, Fuji, Lumix)
- Noam Kroll (founder/colorist)
- Cinematic color correction
- Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom integration
- Free LUT resources
- Portrait and skin tone optimization
- Low light footage recovery
- Apple iPhone filmmaking
- ProRes texture overlays
- Film grain and texture

## Camera-Specific LUTs

- [FREE CAMERA LUTS](https://cinecolor.io/collections/free-camera-luts): Collection of free camera-specific LUTs for Sony, Blackmagic, Canon profiles
- [CAMERA LUTS](https://cinecolor.io/collections/camera-luts): Camera-specific LUT collection for log profiles across major brands
- [SONY S-LOG3: LOW LIGHT](https://cinecolor.io/products/sony-s-log3-lowlight): Sony S-Log3 LUTs optimized for high ISO low light footage recovery
- [APPLE IPHONE](https://cinecolor.io/products/iphone-filmic-set): 2-LUT pack for iPhone footage with filmic and organic aesthetics

## Professional LUT Packs

- [COLOR EQ](https://cinecolor.io/products/color-eq): Advanced technical LUT for intelligent saturation and contrast equalization
- [NATURAL LIGHT](https://cinecolor.io/products/natural-light): Limited edition LUT pack optimized for golden hour and available light
- [INTERVIEW](https://cinecolor.io/products/interview-pre-order): Portrait LUT pack for documentary interviews with skin tone optimization
- [PORTA](https://cinecolor.io/products/porta-400): 10-LUT pack for naturalistic portraiture with film-like skin tones
- [A35 SOFT NOSTALGIC TEXTURE](https://cinecolor.io/products/soft-nostalgic-texture): Arri Alexa 35 film texture overlay in ProRes422HQ format

## Free LUT Downloads

- [Free Adobe Photoshop LUTs](https://cinecolor.io/products/free-adobe-photoshop-luts): Free versatile LUT starter pack for Photoshop in .cube format
- [MAD MAX](https://cinecolor.io/products/mad-max): Free 10-LUT pack inspired by Mad Max with teal/magenta and chrome looks
- [DUO TONE](https://cinecolor.io/products/duo-tone): Free 5-LUT pack with complementary color duo-tone grading styles
- [CLOCKWORK ORANGE](https://cinecolor.io/products/clockwork-orange): Stanley Kubrick-inspired LUT with vivid saturation and filmic contrast
